title: Ashmita Chaliha Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title at Korea Masters
indian_angle: Ashmita Chaliha's victory marks a significant milestone for Indian badminton, as she becomes only the fifth Indian woman to win a Super 300 or higher title.
summary: The 26-year-old Indian shuttler, Ashmita Chaliha, clinched her first BWF World Tour title at the Korea Masters, completing a remarkable comeback after a serious knee injury suffered in 2024.

title: Coach Park Tae-sang's Next Act Takes Shape with Back-to-Back Super 300s
indian_angle: This story highlights the continued success of coach Park Tae-sang, who previously guided PV Sindhu to Olympic bronze, and his ongoing impact on Indian badminton talent.
summary: Park Tae-sang, known for his Olympic success with PV Sindhu, is now achieving back-to-back Super 300 wins, showcasing his evolving coaching journey and influence.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp Begins for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's young talent for upcoming international junior championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian U17 & U15 junior badminton teams has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing players for the upcoming Badminton Asia Junior Championships 2026.

title: Final Selection Trials Underway for BWF World Junior Championships 2026
indian_angle: Indian junior players are currently undergoing final selection trials to represent the country at the prestigious BWF World Junior Championships in Cairo, Egypt.
summary: The final selection trials for Indian players qualified for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026 in Cairo, Egypt, are currently in progress.

title: BAI Implements New 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has adopted a new 3x15 scoring system for U13, U15, and U17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships, impacting junior player development.
summary: The BAI has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U13, U15, and U17 age groups.

title: BAI Issues Advisory Against Unauthorized Badminton Leagues and Tournaments
indian_angle: The BAI has cautioned players and stakeholders against participating in unauthorized badminton leagues and tournaments, emphasizing the importance of official sanctioning.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released an advisory warning against participation in unauthorized badminton leagues, tournaments, and championships, including specific mentions of "Passion Sphere presents Badminton Premier League – Season 2" and "4th Drops & Drives Badminton Tournament".
